parity_goal: Preserve the portable image-first visual-direction walk, visible-choice contract, and exact profile handoff without private workspace assumptions.

cases.prompt: $beauty-director I need a calm, trustworthy direction for a behavioral-health website, but not sterile or spa-like.
expected: routes from the bundled index to three meaningfully different styles
puts every option name, approved reference image, one-liner, first three cues, palette, rationale, and question in one final answer
keeps visual choices out of commentary and allows rejection of all three

cases.prompt: $beauty-director None of these. They are too polished. I want rough screenprint energy and bolder type.
expected: does not ask the user to repeat an already-clear rejection reason
does not repeat rejected styles and returns a new complete rendered choice set
after a selection, stays inside the chosen style and compares its approved anchor and expressions before any broader adjustment

cases.prompt: $beauty-director Ukiyo-e is right for this museum booklet. Good-go. Save the accepted profile in the supplied project.
expected: stops the walk after approval and asks only for a missing destination
writes exactly the required beauty-profile sections with 150 to 250 words of medium-specific application guidance
includes the approved reference plus all required cultural citations and a grounded respectful-use note
